evals.name: mechanical-fixes
evals.prompt: check this plan before I build it: .design/enterprise-tier/TASKS.md
evals.expected_output: Fixes the signature claim (createSession takes userId only) and the script name (no `migrate` script; `db:push` exists) directly in TASKS.md, flags src/lib/cache.ts as nonexistent, lists every edit, and returns Ready without asking permission for corrections that have one right answer.
assertions: Catches that `createSession` takes only `userId` — src/lib/auth.ts defines no tenantId parameter
Catches that `npm run migrate` does not exist; package.json has `db:push`
EDITS TASKS.md itself rather than only reporting the problems
Lists every edit it made in the report
Does not ask permission for corrections that have exactly one right answer
Ends Ready (or Ready-apart-from-a-named-gate) and hands off to /atelier:build

evals.name: ambiguous-step
evals.prompt: check this plan before I build it: .design/enterprise-tier/TASKS.md
evals.expected_output: Recognises task 1 is unrunnable as written — rate limiting per-IP vs per-user vs per-tenant are all defensible and change the implementation. Asks in ONE batched round with a recommendation and the consequence, rather than guessing or handing back a chore list.
assertions: Identifies that 'add rate limiting' is underspecified — the scope key (per-IP / per-user / per-tenant) is not stated
Asks the user rather than silently picking one
Batches its questions into one round instead of trickling them
Gives a recommended answer and the consequence of choosing otherwise
Notes @fastify/rate-limit is not currently a dependency
Does not declare the plan Ready while the ambiguity is unresolved

evals.name: prd-gate
evals.prompt: check this plan before I build it: .design/enterprise-tier/TASKS.md
evals.expected_output: Recognises that the whole plan contradicts PRD 0001's 'On-prem or self-hosted deployment — not ever' non-goal. Treats it as a scope gate: stops, names it, gives the options (amend the PRD or drop the plan), and does NOT edit the plan or the PRD to make it runnable.
assertions: Reads docs/prd/0001-enterprise-tier.md and finds the self-hosting non-goal
Recognises this as a scope gate, not a mechanical fix
STOPS and asks rather than editing the plan to make it buildable
Does NOT edit the PRD to remove or soften the non-goal
Names the options: amend the PRD deliberately, or drop the plan
Does not suggest /atelier:build while the gate is open
